If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: put_item, get_item, query
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dynamodb/

  Interface: sdk

Option 3 — MongoDB Atlas:
  Service: MongoDB Atlas
  SDK: pymongo
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: update_one, find_one, find
  Setup hints: MONGODB_ATLAS_URI
  Official docs: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/

  Service: Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL
  SDK: azure-cosmos
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: upsert_item, read_item, query_items
  Setup hints: AZURE_COSMOS_ENDPOINT, AZURE_COSMOS_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cosmos-db/nosql/

Option 5 — Alibaba Tablestore:
  Service: Alibaba Tablestore
  SDK: tablestore
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: put_row, get_row, update_row
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/tablestore/product-overview/what-is-tablestore

Option 6 — Google Firestore:
  Service: Cloud Firestore
  SDK: google-cloud-firestore
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: document.set, document.get, where
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/firestore/docs

output_text:
import json
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from azure.cosmos import CosmosClient, PartitionKey


def upsert_json_document(
    document: Dict[str, Any],
    *,
    id_field: str = "id",
    database_name: str = "documents_db",
    container_name: str = "documents",
    partition_key_field: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if id_field not in document:
        raise ValueError(f"Document must contain primary identifier field '{id_field}'.")

    endpoint = os.environ["AZURE_COSMOS_ENDPOINT"]
    key = os.environ["AZURE_COSMOS_KEY"]

    client = CosmosClient(endpoint, credential=key)

    try:
        database = client.create_database_if_not_exists(id=database_name)

        pk_field = partition_key_field or id_field
        partition_key_path = f"/{pk_field}"
        container = database.create_container_if_not_exists(
            id=container_name,
            partition_key=PartitionKey(path=partition_key_path),
        )

        if pk_field not in document:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Document must contain partition key field '{pk_field}' for Cosmos DB."
            )

        upserted = container.upsert_item(document)
        return upserted
    finally:
        client.close()


def upsert_json_document_from_str(
    document_json: str,
    *,
    id_field: str = "id",
    database_name: str = "documents_db",
    container_name: str = "documents",
    partition_key_field: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    document = json.loads(document_json)
    return upsert_json_document(
        document,
        id_field=id_field,
        database_name=database_name,
        container_name=container_name,
        partition_key_field=partition_key_field,
    )
